prompts.prompt:
请把这张图做成最终清晰的学术示意图，直接用生图模型编辑，不要输出SVG。保留版式、现有全部文字公式和函数形状，只修下面这些问题。

最重要的是复制同一个J3矩形：主图、右上图例、左侧两行完工例、右侧两行work例，所有粉色J3的长、宽、实心粉色填色完全相同。不要按各自面板宽度拉伸，它们是同一个任务。以左侧拖期行的粉色块为母版，原样复制其物理尺寸到其他五处，仅移动位置。文字可以缩小，矩形不能因此变宽。绿色[e3,d3]区间各处也一样长，约为这个粉色块的两倍。

保留左侧已经对齐的e3、d3两根竖虚线。主图绿色窗口、左侧两行绿色窗口、下面两幅费用图的零区间，都从同一根e3竖线到同一根d3竖线，不改变它们的位置。

右侧work的两条绿色窗口以及其下方函数图的e3/d3必须分别在同一根竖线上。上方绿色窗口左端现在比下方e3偏右，要把上面的左端延伸到下方e3的正上方。不要另画新的投影线。右侧窗口宽度与左侧一致。

work第一行：同样大小的纯粉J3跨过e3，e3穿过其正中间。删掉悬空的EW3双箭头；直接把粉色矩形从左边界S3到e3这一段上边框描成粗蓝色，EW3文字放在它上方。蓝线必须贴在粉色条的上边缘，不得伸到矩形左边界之外。work第二行：同样大小的纯粉J3跨过d3，把从d3到右边界C3的上边框描成粗红色，TW3文字放在上方。粗红线不得超出加工矩形。这样完整纯粉的加工块上方，只有实际窗口外的加工部分以蓝红边框突出。不要再画浮空区间箭头、斜纹或白色附加块。

主图J1和J5的完工点继续落在各自绿色窗口内，Cj黑点都在矩形右端。J5窗口只能标[e5,d5]，所有任务和窗口下标一一对应。其余主图任务和空闲位置不动。

所有任务矩形内部、六个颜色图例都是均匀纯色，平涂，不是有光泽的材质。去掉白色高光、渐变和阴影。蓝橙粉绿紫金六色不变。抬高线条与文字清晰度，正确汉字。底部没有底纹图例。保持下方凸函数、阶跃函数、work五段直线函数和公式不变，阶跃无断点圆圈。输出同样4:3比例、你能支持的最大原生分辨率的一张完整成图，不给变体。

只修右侧上下两组图的共同坐标，其余部分全部保留，不换版式、不改文字公式、不移动粉色加工条。
右上两行的绿色[e3,d3]条，应是左侧绿色[e3,d3]条的等长副本。以右侧目前的e3位置为左端，复制左侧绿色条的长度向右绘制，两行保持完全一致。对应的蓝色上边框终点在e3，红色上边框起点在d3。
把右上这两个绿色端点的竖直投影直接延伸到右下work函数图。右下图的e3、d3刻度和绿色带的左右边界，必须分别落在这同一对竖线上，不能再各画各的。现在右下e3偏左，必须与上方一致。
在这对端点下重画右下函数，严格只有五段直线：
蓝色左平台到e3；
蓝色直线下降到e3+p3，其水平长度必须等于右上粉色J3矩形的长度；
黑色零平台从e3+p3到d3；
红色直线上升到d3+p3，其水平长度也等于同一个粉色J3矩形的长度；
之后红色水平平台。
保留αp3、βp3两个平台高度和五个原有符号标签，不标数值、不加折点。
所有J3粉色矩形内部都是同一均匀纯粉，所有其他加工块和六色图例也均匀平涂，没有白色高光和渐变。维持各处J3同样长度。主图J1、J5的C点仍在各自窗口内。其他全部内容保持原样。最大原生分辨率生成一张完整的4:3成图。

Create ONE clean high-resolution academic scheduling illustration. The reference image supplies the overall appearance and panel hierarchy only. Re-render cleanly from the specifications below rather than copying distorted text. Final output is a raster illustration generated by the image model. 4:3 landscape, maximum native resolution, white background, crisp black outlines, proper serif math, accurately written Chinese. Flat pastel color fills, ZERO shading/gradients/highlights/white patches inside task blocks.

LAYOUT:
Top left: one M1/M2 schedule titled “Work 1：给定窗口的并行机调度”. Top right: “参数与决策”.
Below: left wide group (completion examples then two cost plots vertically stacked), right narrow group (processing-overlap examples then work-cost plot). Thin pale-blue frames and pale-blue section headings. Keep one footer legend.

ONE SHARED TIME SCALE:
Every pink J3 rectangle is a clone, exactly the SAME physical width. Every [e3,d3] green window has the SAME physical width, exactly twice the pink J3 width.
All LEFT time axes use t0 at x9.5%,t28 at x59.5% of the canvas. Thus e3=10 at x27.36%,d3=18 at x41.64%; these two vertical guides project through the top schedule, both left completion examples and both left cost plots, never shifting.
RIGHT axes use t6 at x65%,t24 at x97.14%,same physical time unit. Thus e3 at x72.14%,d3 at x86.43%. Project those two vertical guides through both right examples and work-cost plot. Pink J3 width7.14% of canvas; green window width14.29% EVERYWHERE, including the small parameter legend's job bar. Do not stretch diagrams to fill their panels.

MAIN SCHEDULE (drawing data, DO NOT PRINT numerical times):
J1 blue M1 processing[0,4],fixed window[2,6].
J3 pink M1 processing[6,10],fixed window[10,18].
J5 purple M1 processing[17,23],fixed window[21,25].
J2 orange M2 processing[0,3],fixed window[1,5].
J4 green M2 processing[6,12],fixed window[10,14].
J6 gold M2 processing[12,17],fixed window[15,20].
Every black completion dot is EXACTLY on its rectangle's RIGHT EDGE and labelled C1,C3,C5 (M1) or C2,C4,C6 (M2). Each is inside its own window, so no obvious removable earliness/tardiness in the main illustration. Show blank idle gaps, J4/J6 touching. Label large gaps “Idle time”.
Processing texts EXACTLY J1(p1),J2(p2),J3(p3),J4(p4),J5(p5),J6(p6). Windows EXACTLY [e1,d1],[e2,d2],[e3,d3],[e4,d4],[e5,d5],[e6,d6], each above its corresponding machine row. No mixed subscripts, no e3,d5, no p8.

TOP-RIGHT legend text:
pj：给定加工时长
[ej,dj]：给定交付窗口
Sj：调度决策的开始时刻
Cj：调度确定的完工时刻
Cj=Sj+pj
A SMALL pink J3(p3) bar, same physical width as all other J3, with S3 left,C3 right. No additional window in this legend.

LEFT SHARED COMPLETION EXAMPLE:
Title “同一任务的完工偏差”.
Two rows, same pink J3, same fixed green window[10,18] on the common guides.
“提前完工”: pink job[4,8],black C3 at8,S3 at4. A separate thin blue time-gap stripe directly BELOW axis from C3=8 ALL THE WAY to e3=10, labelled E3.
“拖期完工”: pink job[16,20],black C3 at20,S3 at16. Separate red stripe BELOW axis from d3=18 ALL THE WAY to C3=20,labelled T3.
Job bases remain solid pink, stripes are separate time gaps. Only symbolic labels S3,C3,e3,d3; no numeric times or E/T superscripts.

LEFT FIRST COST PLOT:
Title exactly “Weighted earliness and tardiness cost”.
Subtitle “凸分段线性推广”.
φ3(C3)=αE3+βT3+γ(E3−u)⁺+δ(T3−v)⁺.
Draw exactly FIVE straight pieces, blue left, black zero,red right: steep blue decline to e3−u, then ONE shallower blue line descending directly to e3 at0; black horizontal0 from e3 to d3; shallow red rise to d3+v, then steeper red rise. Slopes −(α+γ),−α,0,β,β+δ. Absolutely NO third blue segment, early zero, curved/wavy segments or slope reversals. Symbolic x ticks e3−u,e3,d3,d3+v. Cost zero window exactly on the shared green guides. Vertical axis “损失”,horizontal C3.

LEFT SECOND COST PLOT:
Title exactly “Weighted number of early and tardy jobs”.
Subtitle “多档阶跃推广”.
φ3(C3)=Σ_r a_r1{E3>u_r}+Σ_r b_r1{T3>v_r}.
Small note “u0=v0=0；单档为标准加权早晚任务数”.
Three BLUE descending stairs; last positive blue stair ends and drops to zero EXACTLY AT e3. Black zero[e3,d3]. Three RED ascending stairs after d3. Horizontal/vertical segments only. NO open/filled dots at breakpoints. Ticks e3−u2,e3−u1,e3,d3,d3+v1,d3+v2. Same common green window guides, no independent stretching.

RIGHT WORK EXAMPLES:
Title “同一任务的窗口外加工量”.
Early job[8,12],late job[16,20]. Both p3=4, both physically identical to all other J3 blocks.
Early row: e3=10 exactly bisects solid pink bar. Draw its top edge from S3=8 to e3=10 in thick BLUE; label EW3 immediately above that short blue top edge. No floating arrow, no extension beyond processing rectangle, no separate blue/white rectangle, no hatching inside pink.
Late row: d3=18 bisects the identical pink bar. Top edge from d3=18 to C3=20 in thick RED,label TW3 above it. Pink fill stays intact. S3/C3 at actual ends,green e3/d3 window endpoints.
Shared windows physically match left windows and project vertically onto work graph.

RIGHT COST PLOT:
Title exactly “Weighted early work and tardy work cost”.
Subtitle “按窗口外实际加工量计费”.
EW3=min{p3,(e3−S3)⁺}
TW3=min{p3,(C3−d3)⁺}
φ3(C3)=αEW3+βTW3.
Positive part is a superscript PLUS, never a star/asterisk.
Exactly five straight pieces: blue plateauαp3 up to e3,blue decline from e3 to e3+p3,black zero[e3+p3,d3],red rise from d3 to d3+p3,red plateauβp3. The horizontal span of each sloped segment equals the physical width of pink J3, because every time scale is shared. e3/d3 match the upper right guides. Symbolic ticks e3,e3+p3,d3,d3+p3. No extra vertices.

BOTTOM LEGEND:
six solid processing colors, black completion dot, green window segment,blue/red loss lines. NO hatch legend. Footer E3=(e3−C3)⁺,T3=(C3−d3)⁺,(x)⁺=max{x,0}; “备选位置不同时执行”.

只修改这张图的标题背景和外框样式，其余内容保持原样：
所有标题栏恢复为很浅、接近白色的淡蓝色，填色参考#EEF5FC，不要深蓝、鲜蓝或饱和的青色。所有卡片外框恢复为纤细的浅蓝线，参考#B9D5EF，线宽像原始参考图那样细，不要粗重描边。标题文字保持黑色、原来字号。
任务加工块的六种颜色、粉色J3、数学公式、函数线、蓝红work上边框、绿色窗口、任务长度与位置、刻度及全部文字都不改。不增加或删减内容，不重新排版，不改变任何下标。
这次只有“标题底色变浅、外框变浅变细”两个改动。保持4:3，最大原生分辨率，输出一张完整PNG图。
